question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

The young fellow was innocent and without __guile__.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Deceit**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the underlined word '**guile**' is '**deceit**'.
 
• **Guile** (कपट/कुतर्क) - Cunning or deceitful behavior; (चालाकी या धोखेबाज़ी का व्यवहार)
 
 
• *Example sentence: He used **guile** to get ahead in his career.*
 
 
 
• **Deceit** (धोखा/छल) - The action or practice of deceiving someone by concealing or misrepresenting the truth; (सच्चाई को छिपाकर या ग़लत तरीके से दिखाकर किसी को धोखा देने की क्रिया या प्रथा।)
 
 
• *Example sentence: She was caught in her **deceit** when her lies were uncovered.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Deceit.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Morality** (नैतिकता / नैतिक मूल्यों) - Principles concerning the distinction between right and wrong or good and bad behavior; (अच्छे और बुरे व्यवहार के बीच अंतर करने के सिद्धांत।)
 
• **Pride** (गर्व / अहंकार) - A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired; (अपनी उपलब्धियों से, जिनके साथ वह गहनता से जुड़ा हुआ है, या विस्तृत रूप से प्रशंसित गुणों या संपत्तियों से उत्पन्न एक गहरी खुशी या संतुष्टि की भावना।)
 
• **Greed** (लोभ / अर्थ की भूख) - Intense and selfish desire for something, especially wealth, power, or food; (कुछ चीज़ के लिए तीव्र और स्वार्थी इच्छा, खासकर धन, शक्ति या भोजन।)
